display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Payments ↔ Settlement Matching
formula_sql:
SELECT
  p.utr_no_,
  p.gross_amount AS payment_received,
  SUM(s.settled_amount) AS sum_of_settlement_lines,
  p.gross_amount - SUM(s.settled_amount) AS variance
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_payments p
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE p.is_active = true
GROUP BY p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount;
